findings.title: Generate the queued timestamp per AssignmentSource instance
findings.body: `timezone.now()` is evaluated once when the module is imported, so every AssignmentSource created without an explicit `queued` value receives the same worker-startup timestamp. Consequently, the `queued` metadata serialized into outbound tasks does not represent when those assignments were queued and can be arbitrarily stale in long-running workers. Use `field(default_factory=timezone.now)` to generate a fresh timestamp for each instance.
